availability.note: new 2026 C350 E sedan listing marked 'New: Available to order' (RRP $99,500 / $99,418). mercedes-benz.com.au configurator returns 403 to this agent, so the manufacturer page could not be opened. CarExpert 18 Aug 2026 confirms the updated C-Class arrives 1H 2027; current W206 is run-out stock/orders.

listPrice.note: CarsGuide MSRP for the 2026 C350 E, 'excludes costs such as stamp duty, other government charges and options'; same $99,418 in Chasing Cars' price box (https://www.chasingcars.com.au/reviews/large-cars/mercedes-benz-c-350e-2026-review/). Launch price $98,200 before on-road costs (CarExpert) rose to $99,500 (C300 at $99,500 before on-roads, CarExpert 25 Feb 2026, C350e priced identically); the 1 Jul 2026 LCT threshold rise trims the LCT component by 0.33×(91,661−91,387)/1.1 ≈ $82 → $99,418, consistent with C300 $99,500 → $99,428 (ordinary threshold, ≈$72) in CarExpert 18 Aug 2026. Manufacturer site 403.

batteryKwh.note: ADAC catalogue (manufacturer data) for C 300 e RWD 230kW from 04/25: 25.4 kWh gross / 19.5 kWh net; CarExpert spec table also '19.5kWh (usable)'

rangeKm.note: WLTP electric 116 km, C 300 e AMG Line Advanced Plus RWD on 18-inch (225/45R18 / 255/40R18), the same 230kW RWD 18-inch AMG Line spec as the Australian C350e. AU figure is 104 km NEDC (ADR 81/02), rejected per range standard rule.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm × 100 = 19.5/116×100 = 16.81. ADAC's 14.6 kWh/100km is the combined (utility-factor weighted) figure, not EV-mode, so not used.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch bei leerer Batterie' WLTP 6.6 L/100km for the RWD 230kW 18-inch car (04/25-on). Mercedes-Benz Australia's own quoted battery-empty figure is 7.6 L/100km (CarsGuide review, https://www.carsguide.com.au/ev/mercedes-benz-c350e-99839), standard unstated; the 4MATIC European car is 7.1. Siblings: audi-a5-phev 7.3, bmw-x3-phev 7.6, mercedes-glc-phev 7.8 — lighter RWD sedan below them is consistent.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: claimed combined label 1.5 L/100km ≤ 3.5 (also CarExpert review)

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO: green passenger car = combined tailpipe CO2 ≤ 120 g/km; ADAC lists 47 g/km WLTP combined, AU label 1.5 L/100km ≈ 35 g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 315 L (VDA, to the cover); also CarExpert, Chasing Cars, carbuyer.co.uk, jesmb.de (455 L non-PHEV)

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: no seats-folded figure published for the saloon (ADAC, carbuyer, jesmb.de checked). 315 × ~1.6, the folded/up ratio of trunk sedans in the dataset (bmw-i5 785/490 = 1.60, tesla-model-3 977/594 = 1.64); held judged value kept

towKg.note: Anhängelast gebremst 1800 kg (12%); CarsGuide towing page lists 1800 kg braked for 2025 and 2026 C350 E (https://www.carsguide.com.au/mercedes-benz/c350-e/towing-capacity)

warrantyYears.note: five-year, unlimited-kilometre warranty in Australia; not conditional on dealer servicing

insuranceAnnual.note: kept at held value; anchored to audi-a5-phev-e-hybrid-quattro ($89,900, 2350) and mercedes-glc-phev-350e-4matic ($99,900, 2500)

depreciationCurve.note: owner convention 2026-11-26: one curve per brand, matching mercedes-eqa (refreshed today). Previously [1,0.65,0.54,0.46,0.39,0.33]; run-out of the W206 ahead of the 1H 2027 update argues for the steeper side, but brand convention governs.

lowConfidence: mercedes-c-350e-phev-350e.availability: manufacturer configurator 403; orderability rests on a CarsGuide new-car 'available to order' listing and the absence of any discontinuation report. Run-out model, update due 1H 2027

mercedes-c-350e-phev-350e.listPrice: $99,418 from CarsGuide/Chasing Cars MSRP boxes, not opened on Mercedes' own site; reconciles with CarExpert's C300 $99,428 via the July 2026 LCT threshold change, but no source states the C350e figure 'before on-road costs' in a dated news item
mercedes-c-350e-phev-350e.fuelConsumptionL100km: ADAC WLTP 6.6 vs Mercedes AU-quoted 7.6 (via CarsGuide); used the WLTP figure
mercedes-c-350e-phev-350e.rangeKm: 116 km is the European 04/25-on WLTP figure; earlier European data gave 115 and AU car is certified 104 km NEDC
